title: Grace
definition: Grace is God’s free and undeserved favor toward sinners, shown supremely in Jesus Christ and given apart from human merit.
summary: Grace does not ignore sin; it overcomes sin through Christ. It forgives, transforms, teaches, and sustains the believer.
christFocus: Grace brings us to the cross and keeps us there. In Christ, God gives what we could never earn and does what we could never accomplish.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Grace is undeserved favor rooted in God’s character.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Grace trains believers to live godly lives by dependence on Christ.
